Name: Configurable Machine Speed
Author: AditOliSamping
Description:
[left][b]Configurable Machine Speed[/b]
[b]Take control of how long your machines take to process items.[/b]
Configurable Machine Speed lets you set an exact processing time for each supported machine, keep its vanilla timing, or enable Instant Output when you just don't feel like waiting.
Processing times are entered directly in minutes, so precise values like [b]25 minutes[/b] are easy to configure without wrestling with a huge slider or manually editing
[code]config.json[/code]
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Configure exact processing times for [b]23 supported machines[/b].[/*]
[*]Enter any whole-minute value directly through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Set a machine to [b]0 / Default[/b] to keep its vanilla processing time.[/*]
[*]Enable [b]Instant Output[/b] for individual machines.[/*]
[*]Instant Output from manual insertion sends completed products directly to your inventory.[/*]
[*]If your inventory is full, the product safely remains ready inside the machine.[/*]
[*]Crystalarium repeat cycles respect your configured processing time.[/*]
[*]Crystalarium Instant mode makes each repeat output immediately ready without creating an automatic infinite-output loop.[/*]
[*]Configure [b]Cask aging[/b] separately by days.[/*]
[*]Optional [b]Instant Iridium[/b] setting for Casks.[/*]
[*]Incubators can complete their timer immediately while keeping Stardew Valley's normal hatching lifecycle.[/*]
[*]Automate remains optional and can continue routing machine output to chests normally.[/*]
[/list][heading]Supported Machines[/heading]
[b]Smelting & Processing[/b]
Furnace, Heavy Furnace, Charcoal Kiln, Bone Mill, Geode Crusher, Deconstructor, Wood Chipper, Recycling Machine, Bait Maker, Fish Smoker
[b]Artisan Machines[/b]
Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayonnaise Machine, Loom, Oil Maker, Dehydrator
[b]Incubators[/b]
Coop Incubator, Ostrich Incubator, Slime Incubator
[b]Other Machines[/b]
Slime Egg Press, Seed Maker, Crystalarium
[b]Aging[/b]
Cask
[heading]How It Works[/heading]
For each machine you can choose:
[b]Default / 0 minutes[/b]
Uses Stardew Valley's normal processing time.
[b]Custom Processing Time[/b]
Enter the exact number of minutes you want.
[b]Instant Output[/b]
Overrides the custom processing time and completes the machine immediately.
Settings apply when a machine starts a new production cycle. Machines that are already processing are generally not rewritten retroactively.
Stardew Valley still handles the actual recipe, ingredient consumption, output item, quality, and machine rules normally. This mod changes the timing rather than replacing the game's machine recipes.
[heading]Crystalarium[/heading]
Crystalariums have a repeating production cycle, so they receive some special handling.
With a custom processing time, each repeat cycle uses your configured value.
With Instant Output enabled, the next Crystalarium product becomes immediately ready after collection. Repeat products still require player interaction to collect, preventing recursive or uncontrolled automatic item generation.
[heading]Casks[/heading]
Casks use their own day-based settings instead of machine minutes.
You can configure how many days they take to reach Iridium quality or enable [b]Instant Iridium[/b].
[heading]Automate Compatibility[/heading]
[b]Automate is optional and is not required.[/b]
Manual insertion can use Instant Output normally, while automated machine input isn't redirected into the local player's inventory. This allows Automate to continue handling output through its normal chest-routing behavior.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional, but highly recommended for easy in-game configuration[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract Configurable Machine Speed into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open Generic Mod Config Menu and configure each machine however you like.[/*]
[/list][heading]Source Code[/heading]
Source code is available on GitHub:
[url=https://github.com/Adit-Oli-Samping/Configurable-Machine-Speed]https://github.com/Adit-Oli-Samping/Configurable-Machine-Speed[/url]
Bug reports and feedback are welcome.[/left]
